notes.title: Smoother Sessions Ahead - Performance Hotfix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/18553b063b713620838db4d6111a6e8797ecd25f.jpg[/img]

Hey Gas Jockeys!

We’ve rolled out a long-awaited performance improvement. A critical issue that caused the game to slow down over time during extended play sessions has been resolved. Performance should improve for PC players, especially during longer playtimes.

This fix involves correcting NPC navigation and reducing the map's generated paths. The optimization keeps NPC movement quality intact while significantly improving overall performance.

As a result, the game now runs much smoother, and FPS drops after long sessions should no longer appear.

Thank you all for your feedback and reports. We truly appreciate them, and they helped us improve the game’s stability and performance. 

~ Kinia

notes.title: A glimpse into some minigames coming to RV Camp DLC – Development Update #3
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1][p]It’s been a while since we last shared something about our upcoming Gas Station Simulator – RV Camp DLC. But hey – it’s summertime, so a little break is more than welcome, right? And speaking of summertime – what are your plans for the holidays? Maybe even a trip to an RV camp with your loved ones? Or simply charging up your batteries while playing your favourite games (which obviously means Gas Station Sim, of course)? Don’t hesitate to let me know in the comments! ☀️[/p][p]Now, let’s get back on track. Today, it’s high time [b]we finally talk a little more about the gameplay itself[/b]. And if we’re talking gameplay, that obviously means minigames. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be a proper Gas Station Simulator DLC, right? Anyway, let’s not waste any more time—grab something refreshing to drink, and let’s get the party started. 🔥[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/f1112048db7a9a4700a8d3495aac92f664dd31f5.png"][/img][/p][h2]Shooting Range 🔫[/h2][p]First of all, let me ask you one more question – is there anyone here who remembers the good old Chicken Shoot game? I remember when I was eight, I would constantly make fun of my mum and kind of bully her for a terrible score – only to find out later that I couldn’t even beat her lowest one. But wait a second – why am I even bothering you with this nonsense, you might ask? Well, it’s because the [b]shooting range minigame in the RV Camp DLC is kind of similar to Chicken Shoot[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/f684163bb47b8d25ce252ba30d3946a8eb2d3daf.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Please keep in mind that everything you see above is still work in progress. I just wanted to show you this material, so you can get a better glimpse of how the minigame looks like.[/i][/p][p]
The idea is pretty simple – [b]you face off against a guest to see who can score more points within 60 seconds[/b]. You’ll use your mouse to aim and shoot red targets while avoiding blue ones, which subtract points from your score. But watch out for special neutral targets like UFOs and coyotes – shooting them before your opponent gives you valuable extra points. Just like any other minigame in the RV Camp DLC, the shooting range offers three different difficulty levels to push your boundaries even further.[/p][p][/p][h2]Dishwashing 🍽️[/h2][p]Now it’s time to talk about everyone’s favourite task of the day – dishwashing. Well, I feel like the name speaks for itself, but just in case you need a bit more explanation: you’ll need to wash a stack of dirty dishes before the water consumption bar runs out.[/p][p]As simple as it sounds, it might be much harder than you expect. First, after you clean the dish [b]you need to place it in the correct category[/b], and all of this while managing water usage efficiently. The upper bar (which right now shows the ECO phase, but it will be changed) will be divided into three sections. [b]Depending on which section you finish, the higher the score will be[/b]. Fail to wash the dishes in time, and the service remains incomplete and you’ll have to try again. Now, enjoy this high-quality GIF of me cleaning the nasty dishes left by those pesky guests.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/6870156426d258a33f1a3ed9e0326208f1a56004.gif"][/img][/p][h2]BBQ 🔥[/h2][p]It wouldn’t be a proper RV camp without the smell of juicy sausages and the sound of sizzling on the grill. In the barbecue minigame, you’ll take charge of the cookinging– duh. It’s a simple and relaxing minigame, in [b]which you have to wait for the exact moment to take the meat from the grill[/b]. However, you’ll need to work fast and smart: serve everything before it burns, but on the other hand make sure it’s properly cooked. Otherwise the whole meal’s ruined. Choose your difficulty to spice things up, with more food types and a chance to earn bigger service cooldown bonuses. But be careful – burn even one item, and the guests won’t be impressed..[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/260fad5376f156001cf289c5cb562faefb55adf4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Stay Up-to-Date 📰[/h2][p]And unfortunately, that’s it for today. So, how did you enjoy this development update? Which minigame excites you the most? Or maybe you have some brand-new ones you’d like to see next? Don’t hesitate to leave a comment down below. Work on the DLC continues, and you can expect another sneak peek at the end of August. Until then, don’t forget to add the DLC to your wishlist.[/p][p]Have a wonderful rest of your day and a great weekend ahead. Cheers! 👋[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543920/Gas_Station_Simulator__RV_Camp_DLC/"][/dynamiclink][i]P.S. Just before I let you go, there’s one more thing I’d like to share...[/i][/p][p][i]Our friends from [b]Garage Monkeys[/b] have announced another update for [b]Car Dealer Simulator[/b], which will include an online parts store.[/i][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][i]~Sewek[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: I’m Ruby with a shotgun – RV Camp DLC development update #2
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h2][p]
Welcome to another development sneak peek at our upcoming Gas Station Simulator – RV Camp DLC! First and foremost, thank you so much for the invaluable feedback we received following the recent announcement. The design and production teams have already reviewed your suggestions and are currently exploring the possibility of including them in the DLC.

But let’s hit the road again and get back to the main topic of today’s devlog: the story and central character of this DLC – Ruby. Let’s roll! 🔥

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/4ae704760e6dafedd4cc2b62284909074c1443e6.jpg"][/img]\[/p][/p][h2]The Harsh Beginnings 😳[/h2][p]
The story begins when your character takes a curious detour to investigate a new business not far from your thriving gas station. That business? A dusty, fledgling RV Camp business established on ash and dust.

You barely set foot past the entrance when you meet Ruby. She’s not exactly what you’d call welcoming. With a shotgun in one hand and a few words from the “bad” category in another, she makes it clear she’s not very fond of you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/7ded22e0d0fd3f3691566577748769bc124032f2.jpg"][/img]Studies show that people often form their first impression within 7 to 10 seconds – and you can bet Ruby doesn’t leave a great one. But even that can be misleading.

Once Ruby learns who you are (yep, the person behind that booming gas station), her tone changes. She sees potential – but more importantly, She sees someone who might just help her biggest life change come true..

[/p][h2]New Troubles Arise 📈[/h2][p]
As you begin working with Ruby, you’re introduced to the unique mechanics of RV camp management. She becomes your mentor – quick to point out mistakes, slow to give praise, and never off her game.

It’s not long before the camp begins to grow. With Ruby’s extended family – colorful cousins with quirks aplenty (and yes, they’ll be your employees) – the place slowly starts to come alive. But just as things are finally coming together, a familiar face may appear once again to change your plans.

And if you thought I’ll share who that might be – you’re more than wrong. I’ve promised myself that there’ll be no spoilers, so don’t tempt me to share anything with you 😉

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/f77ca035134a3e9633bc9e5763f0f970f5dc4f17.png"][/img][/p][h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2][p]
That’s it for today! As always, drop us a comment and let us know what you think about our fiery new friend, Ruby. Feel free to share your suggestions for the upcoming DLC as well. And if you haven’t already, add the RV Camp DLC to your wishlist to stay in the loop.

Until the next devlog! 👋[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543920/Gas_Station_Simulator__RV_Camp_DLC/"][/dynamiclink]

[i]P.S.: Check out what our buddies over at [b]Garage Monkeys[/b] have been up to – they just dropped some new cars into [b]Car Dealer Simulator[/b]! Looks like your virtual showroom might need a little expansion... 🚗💥[/i] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink] ~Sewek [/p]

notes.title: Physics & Popularity Balance Update
notes.notes:
[b][h2]New & Improved: 🔧[/h2][/b]

[b]Balance for Custom Gas Prices: [/b]The Custom Gas Prices balance patch fixes gameplay issues where fuel prices led to overly reduced traffic in the early game. Traffic behavior is now more balanced, making the system feel more fair at the beginning of the game. Setting a New Fuel Price should close/open fuel pumps to reset the Traffic
Small changes to the questline in the early game.
Added NPCs to the Tidal Wave Volcano cinematic even if Traffic is very low.

notes.title: Booking, Guests, and Events – RV Camp DLC development update #1🔥
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

The past couple of days have been a hell of a ride for us – not only did we release long-awaited [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620?emclan=103582791465284088&emgid=502825815722951734]controller support[/url] along with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620?emclan=103582791465284088&emgid=562497971311083642]dynamic fuel prices update[/url] for Gas Station Simulator, but we also hosted our own Franchise Sale, where we finally announced a brand-new expansion for Gas Station Simulator. And that’s gonna be the main topic of today’s development update. If you somehow missed the initial announcement, feel free to check out the Steam page for some further information regarding the DLC.

Now, today we’ll delve into some essential information – we’ll be talking about your potential guests (and their needs, and trust me – they can be very picky), how the whole booking system works within the game, and possible events you might encounter (it wouldn’t be a proper DLC without those, right?). So, hop in, fasten your seatbelt, and let’s ride! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/8af9d375ebf49856df713a85b3b0fc1526706595.jpg[/img]

[h2]Booking 📅[/h2]

Let’s start from the very beginning. So far, every single DLC that we’ve released for Gas Station Sim has a go-to structure that contains all of the necessary details you need to know if you want to ensure proper functioning of your business. For the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782920/Gas_Station_Simulator__Car_Junkyard_DLC/]Car Junkyard DLC[/url] we have a board, for instance. With the RV Camp DLC, the situation is gonna be basically the same, but instead of a board, you’ll spend a huge chunk of your time going through the Guest Book (code name for now, might be changed in the future).

Now, within the Guest Book, you will find all of the necessary details. This includes information about your guests (more on that below), available parking spots, campers waiting in the queue, and most importantly, a check-in option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/c5a9ebf3f8e1deefef08de96afff4ce94f8a2c27.jpg[/img]
[i]Please keep in mind that the image above is still work-in-progress and does not showcase the actual footage that will be coming to the game. [/i]

[h2]Guests 🧑[/h2]

Guests are the equivalent of customers who stop by your gas station. However, every single guest has a certain set of services that you will need to complete to increase their wellness level, which, to put it simply – will result in higher income.

Now, you might be wondering what kind of services you will have to provide. While that’s a pretty damn good question and ideally the topic for a whole new devlog, I can’t stop myself from giving you some spoilers. So, let’s say these services might include doing the laundry, setting up the SPA, or serving some juicy sausages right from the barbecue. But we’re more than open to your suggestions, so let us know in the comments what you think about these services and if you have any ideas, feel free to share them with us as well.

[h2]Events 🎙️[/h2]

As I wrote at the beginning of this announcement – you wouldn’t call it a proper DLC without some DLC-related events. And that’s where the bad news comes into play, because you might expect the return of a real pain in the butt. Yes – I’m talking about Dennis. The disturbing kiddo doesn’t give up that easily, and in the RV Camp DLC, he will do whatever it takes to make your guests’ lives miserable. Let’s see below what he has in store this time 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/e3fb6d60b3f4c186bc42389682e80019486ca0c8.jpg[/img]

[i]Just like the above – this is only to showcase you heavy work-in-progress stuff, so you can better understand and visualize the whole feature. [/i]

[h2]WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale 🐬[/h2]

We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation, for World Ocean Day!

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025, and you can save a fin-tastic 45% off Gas Station Simulator. We will also donate 10% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.

[h2]How your support will help this year 🤔[/h2]

By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue their global conservation work, as well as their ghost gear removal project, funding 10 missions for divers to remove lethal entanglement hazards to marine life (and scuba divers) from reefs, seabeds, and shipwrecks in UK seas.

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring, intelligent beings. The ocean produces more oxygen and absorbs more carbon than all of Earth's forests combined, and whales help it flourish. Yet 300,000 whales die in fishing gear every year.

[url=https://bit.ly/WODSale25][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/e38cddd5275d93344bf208c7b6f8826b10dc9878.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

Unfortunately, every great thing must come to an end! As always, feel free to share your feedback with us in the comments down below. You can expect the next development update for RV Camp DLC by the end of this month, where we’ll dive into the story aspect of the DLC as well as the main character – Ruby. Don’t forget to wishlist the DLC if you want to stay in the loop of everything RV Camp DLC, and until then, enjoy your day and weekend ahead and we will hear from each other by the end of June.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543920/Gas_Station_Simulator__RV_Camp_DLC/

Now you can rev up your entrepreneurial dreams, negotiating deals, haggling like a pro, and pretending to know what "force majeure" means. And if your wallet’s feeling shy, grab the bundle with Gas Station Simulator for an extra dose of automotive madness—in one package, less cash needed! Hurry, before pixels sell out![/i]

It was a really difficult decision for us, and we want to go through this time together with you. Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us, we do really appreciate and hope for your understanding of this situation and we do what we can to entertain you Gas Jockeys with all the content being added to the game.

notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Gas Jockeys![/h1]

We’re excited to share the first glimpse of our upcoming update: custom fuel pricing paired with the brand-new Traffic Meter. These two systems work in tandem to give you deeper control over customer flow and profitability than ever before.

[h2][b]Custom Fuel Pricing[/b][/h2]

A new, intuitive slider lets you set pump rates anywhere within a defined bracket (for example, $1.50–$2.00). As you tweak the price:
[list]
[*] [b]Lower Rates[/b] draw in more budget-driven drivers, boosting traffic and overall sales volume.
[*] [b]Higher Rates[/b] slim your customer base but increase profit per liter sold.
[/list]
This direct trade-off is designed to inject meaningful strategy into each pricing decision. Early playtests suggest that small adjustments—just $0.05 up or down—can shift your daily revenue by noticeable margins. Your goal? Find that sweet spot where volume and margin intersect for maximum daily haul.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/82432e408c675733e8f755784c865b748cbf551a.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Traffic Meter[/b][/h2]

Located in the upper left corner of the HUD, the Traffic Meter displays real-time road activity on a scale from VERY LOW to EXTREMELY HIGH. It aggregates multiple gameplay factors like time, popularity, fuel price, decorations, landmarks or upcoming events, so you can instantly see how attractive your station is to passing drivers:

[list]
[*] [b]Responsive Feedback:[/b] Watch the meter climb during peak hours, after adding new decorations or landmarks, or when you roll out limited-time discounts.
[*] [b]Strategic Timing:[/b] Spot impending dips in traffic and preemptively launch flash sales—or capitalize on surges by raising prices slightly for extra profit.
[*] [b]At-a-Glance Clarity:[/b] Color-coded segments help you read conditions instantly: blue for LOW, green for NORMAL, yellow for HIGH, and red for EXTREMELY HIGH.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/39968516d0cbaffe5e4d2552b3bab84fd8b91cf2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/72cd216668deffbd199e48b3ef386e616c2555b9.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Why This Matters[/b][/h2]

By linking pricing and traffic, we’ve added layers of tactical depth and replayability:

[list]
[*] [b]Revenue Optimization: [/b]Track how every pump-price tweak affects both volume and per-sale profit, all within one unified interface.
[*] [b]Dynamic Variety:[/b] Time-of-day bonuses, special in-game events, and your own pricing choices now interact in rich, evolving ways—no two days play out the same.
[*] [b]Player Agency:[/b] Whether you aim for mass-market dominance with rock-bottom rates or carve out a high-end niche, these tools empower you to define and refine your unique strategy.
[/list]

[h2][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/h2]

This is only the beginning. We’ll be rolling out additional features and surprises in future devlogs—so stay tuned for more insights into how we’re expanding gameplay depth and player choice.

[*] We added extra information to the contract completion screen like Car Price or Investor Share
[*] Added extra animations to Fame Tab
[*] Added new progress bar to the Fame Tab
[/list]
[h1]Patch Notes for Revamp🚀[/h1] 
The goal of the revamp was to fix all the visual defects that had been bothering us for a long time and thus refresh the look and mood of the game. At the same time, we took care of the original feeling of our title. We wanted to make something the same. We just wanted to have our game stay the same but better:) To do that we decided to do a complete rework of a Couple of features:

[h3]Foliage[/h3]
The goal here was to eliminate the unnecessary optimizations we had made in the past and restore the original quality of grasses, cactuses, and all the props that make up a large part of what you see on the monitor.

[h3]Landscape[/h3]
Close-up quality, getting rid of obvious glitches and artifacts. Retaining the color palette and adding features at higher scalability levels

[h3]Rocks[/h3]
We completely replaced every rock in the game. Again, taking care of the color palette, we added and reworked channels to fully use computing power.

[h3]Global colors of the project[/h3]
To the best of our abilities, we went over the entire project, adjusting the colors of the models not only to the color palette of the rest of the game but also to Physically accurate standards of the modern gaming rendering pipeline. This enabled us to bring the details to the places in the game that were previously lacking.

[h3]New Lighting and Color grading[/h3]
The changes were very delicately executed. As mentioned previously. We wanted to retain the original feeling and make things look better at the same time. The point of reference was 12.00. This is traditionally the least appealing hour for many reasons. We worked hard to enhance the world at this very hour because we knew the 17.00 will look sweet anyway:)

[h1]Optimization Patch notes📈[/h1]

We tested and focused mainly on older machines. However, we provided a significant performance boost for all graphics settings.

[h2]New Graphic setting[/h2]

The goal was to optimize the game to the point that it would enable it to run comfortably on a PC with integrated GPU (without dedicated GPU). We created a new graphic setting that is situated below the LOW scalability setting. It is dedicated mainly to common business notebook machines that were never prepared to run games in the first place.

GTX 960, which was our minimum spec GPU prepared to run the game on LOW scalability settings, now runs the High scalability settings at about 30 FPS. If the performance is your priority you are free to play around with the scalability setting to find something that runs well and has visual fidelity of your liking.

Removed unbound Lock FPS settings: The new Max is 240.

Epic settings have been merged into High settings. That being said we decided to remove Epic settings as it became unnecessary.

[h2]Among other things reworked we focused on the following:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked outline selection method
[*] Reworked landscape texturing method, implementation, and features
[*] Reflection capture method
[*] Brought quality Materials on all props to work properly with graphic settings
[*] Reworked Sky
[*] Reduced shader complexity for many shaders
[*] Reworked mount Urulu
[*] Numerous other performance improvements
[/list]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

So, there you have it! Don’t forget to share your feedback with us below or on our official discord server. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts regarding the update. Last but not least, if you encounter any issues or weird stuff in the game, send us a ticket to support@drago-entertainment.com or use our new tool - Bug Reporter. 

Until the next devlog! 

[i]~Sewek[/i]

notes.title: Community Announcement & Release Agenda
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b9bb0199da6c050d161053f56b30283a344818af.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]We would like to address the topic of issues and bugs in the game. [/b][/h2]

Some of you have been quite vocal about it and we do agree with you, more needs to be done. It’s something we were well aware of for a long time and did a lot to deal with it, but the problem is always the same: it’s extremely time consuming and difficult to fix bugs that we do not encounter and/or are unable to reproduce. 

Here we rely mostly on the saved games sent to us. While in many cases it allows us to find the bug and usually reproduce the situation the player has encountered, analyzing saved games is a lengthy process and does not always end with success. This in turn means bug fixing is going very slowly.

[h3][b]Crash & Bug Reporting Tool[/b][/h3]

We have recently introduced a crash reporting tool in our studio, and have been improving it since then and we reached a very satisfying state that will be patched into the base game together with a new in-game bug reporting tool shortly after the release of the Car Junkyard DLC. Whenever you report an issue then, we get a pretty precise “where” and “when” in the code of the game, speeding up bug finding immensely.
On top of that we will also be able to collect crash and bug report data and have the system show us how often these occur in order to prioritize which ones affect the most players and deal with those issues first.

[h3][b]Gas Station Simulator Team[/b][/h3]

When it comes to the people working on Gas Station Simulator, there is something you should know: the team is divided into two sub-teams. One creating the paid DLCs and the other handling the base game only - this means updates, bug fixes and free DLCs. Going forward, we are moving some people around to strengthen the base game team, allowing for more developers to work on fixing bugs and issues as well as speed up the implementation of improvements. Having taken so long to implement certain improvements like grid snapping was a bit embarrassing, even we have to admit that.

Exciting news ahead – today we’re thrilled to share the release date for the upcoming Car Junkyard DLC. If you think that’s all then allow me to surprise ya all. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/61197500b5334857d076bbb44c42c6b0ef82a9d1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Car Junkyard DLC teaser and the release date 👀[/h2]

Sean, a daydreamer with muscle cars know-how but little to zero financial knowledge, is on the lookout for someone who will help him turn his falling business into a money making machine. That’s where you come in. New challenges, missions, story, mechanics, and business await. All of this available on [b]August 15th, 2024 for 16.99 USD[/b].

[previewyoutube=c0epi6-9upc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]VIP Update is here 🕵️[/h2]

That’s right! From now on a VIP customer will visit your station from time to time. Basically, you wanna serve him just like a normal client but there is a catch – serve him properly a couple of times in a row to receive a special bonus which will boost all of the sources of your income. However, there is one difference that distinguishes VIP customer from a normal one and that is its own cooldown. As soon as you serve the VIP client you’re gonna have to wait a couple of minutes until he comes back again, so you don’t have to stand on your tiptoes 24/7. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b7a9b0250770df2a5d64547ce1aeb1003098c3c6.jpg[/img]
[i]wake up gas jockey, we have a VIP customer to serve[/i]

[h2]Transfer between DLCs 👀[/h2]

From now on you can freely move between maps if you happen to own a particular DLC. Right now you can transfer between Tidal Wave and Route 66 but we’re planning to expand this feature for a Shady Deals map as well. If you want to transfer your character to a different map all you need to do is simple interaction with the sign post below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/fd163cc24f31069ff308b5fb0a90dec21fcec7c3.jpg[/img]

With this update we’re also introducing a brand-new feature called passive income. The idea is simple – if you’ve unlocked different maps (in this case Tidal Wave and Route 66) they can basically profit from each other. The amount received is calculated based on the average income of your Costs and Revenues from the last seven days on the given map. In other words – you need to spend at least seven days on a particular map. Otherwise the system won’t be able to calculate how much passive income you should get. You can delve into all of the necessary statistics in the section in the Economy Tab called “Passive Income”. As always – I’m counting on your feedback, folks! 

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s gonna be it for today! So, how do you like our little surprise? Feedback is much appreciated so go now and enjoy a fresh update. I can’t wait to see your comments regarding both the trailer and VIP update, so do not let me down, okay? And last but not least for all of the things related to Gas Station Simulator and upcoming DLC, stick with us and consider adding the game to your wishlist 🙇Until the next devlog!

An Economy Update involves a comprehensive rebalancing of various in-game elements related to finances, prices, and economic interactions. In this update, we've focused on refining the pricing structures for gas. Additionally, we've introduced new features like a dynamic gas pricing curve, delivery fees, and expanded loan options to add depth and complexity to the game's economic landscape.

[h3]Gas Pricing ⛽[/h3]

With this update, we’re finally adding a visible dynamic pricing curve for gas. This curve will reflect recent price trends, providing you with a more realistic and dynamic market to navigate. Keep an eye on the gas ordering interface to stay informed about the current pricing trends.

[list]

[*]$250 - $450 (12 minutes to pay back)

Today we’re going to shed some light on the trading aspect that is coming with the Gas Station Simulator - Airstrip DLC. Without further ado, let’s get some trades going! 

[h2]Trading System 💰[/h2]

Occasionally, your Airstrip will have the unique opportunity to welcome country-related planes. Each plane will have a different set of products at its disposal, so you'll be able to get some unique items each time they arrive at your airstrip. To make a deal, you’ll need to make sure that your stock is full of high-quality items, as this will boost your chances for a successful trade. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/d72ef8064a91cb322c391227ec55e37ad2b024f4.gif[/img]

Your chances of success are indicated by a circle that, depending on the item's quality and the amount you want to sell or buy, will change accordingly. It’s totally up to you whether you want to try your luck or not – the rewards might be worth a try, but you have to keep in mind that the pilot might not want to give you a second chance. However, some tricks will aid you or make your life a little harder as you progress through the game. 

[h2]Boosts 📈 & Impediments📉[/h2]

Boosts are randomly generated events that create additional opportunities for the player to get a particular item at a preferential price. They can appear both on the players' and pilots' sides, but there is no possibility that they will show up on both sides at the same time. There is only one exception to that rule, but we’ll leave it for you to discover it when the [b]Gas Station Simulator - Airstrip DLC releases on April 28th, 2023![/b]

On the other hand, you’ll also encounter some obstacles along your trading journey. While boosts will significantly help you, the impediments are designed to make the gameplay more challenging. 

[h2]Card System 💳[/h2]

To make trading a little easier, we’re adding some active cards that you’ll be able to get if you complete a specific set of tasks in the game. notes.title: Update #7 is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/063c1681b53344e1533af0823d527c594e69ed4a.jpg[/img]

Update #7 is here! While the major goal of this update has been stability and especially CPU performance, we also added some new features and general gameplay improvements.
The CPU focus allows us to further increase frame rates going forward.
We also moved to an updated version of the game’s engine and switched to DirectX 12 which in itself should provide even further improvements.

This update also introduces some changes to the AI. In order to avoid problems with traffic or customers, it might be necessary to reset the traffic using the Big Red Button at the Dust Bowl sign when you first start the game after the update.


[h3]Features & Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] There is now a management tab on the PC that allows you to open/close all areas of the gas station. This allows you better control of how busy you want things to be at any given time.
[*] A new caravan section has been added allowing you to hire an additional employee for a total of 6 employees helping you out on the gas station.
[*] Enjoy even more freedom to customize your station thanks to the new Landmark list which allows you to hide any large decorations around the station.
[*] A new landmark has been added. It’s a wreck of an old food truck.
[*] A new unique NPC has been added. Clara is a reference to our other game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160920/Food_Truck_Simulator/]Food Truck Simulator[/url] where she plays a major role.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sprint is finally here. Serve your gas station customers even more efficiently thanks to faster movement by using the SHIFT button.
[*] A new AI task randomization system has been implemented that should provide a bit more randomness in customer arrival orders to make it feel a bit less superficial.
[*] The thresholds for popularity levels have been significantly lowered across the board. We also added 9 new popularity levels in preparation for the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126170/Gas_Station_Simulator__Party_Time_DLC/]Party Time DLC[/url] that will further improve the popularity situation many players complained about.
[*] Fuel Capacity saving/loading should now always be working properly. In certain cases when loading a saved game you could lose the fuel in the truck that was about to deliver it to your gas station.
[*] Warehouse Capacity should now be calculated correctly when saving/loading games. In some conditions they did previously show the wrong values.
[/list]

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] The “artworks” created by Dennis will now be destroyed after customizing a new wall with the hammer tool and paying the price.
[*] Tools in hand should no longer wrongly rotate under certain conditions.
[*] Fixes an issue that caused customers to "drive in air" while returning to their vehicle.
[/list]

[h3]Employees[/h3]
[list]
[*] Employees should now be smarter when cleaning and will no longer go for the same trash items or objects all the time.
[*] You can hire one more employee for up to 6 total.
[*] The scanner and baskets will now appear when an employee is serving customers at the cash register.
[/list]

[h3]Stability[/h3]
We did quite a lot of small fixes in many areas when it comes to stability and you should see a significant improvement in that area. As for the bigger fixes, this update does:
[list]
[*] Fixes an issue within the physics subsystem that was responsible for a significant amount of crashes, especially in later stages of the game.
[*] Fixes various memory issues within the UI that would eventually lead to the game crashing. 
[*] Fixes another nasty memory leak when invoking the in-game menu (ESC) on system with 8GB of RAM or less.
[/list]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gas Station Simulator has been moved to a new engine version and now by default supports DirectX 12. This helps with some of the performance improvements. Should your GPU not support DirectX 12, you can still run the game in DirectX 11 mode by launching the game with the optional parameter -d3d11. 
[*] Switching to the new engine also allowed us to use various package and asset optimizations which resulted in reducing the size game assets take on your SDD/HDD (about 3-5GB depending on DLCs). Storage space saving however were not our primary consideration, but the fact that the less storage space game assets take, the less time it takes to load them.
[*] This update also features a series of optimizations and improvements across the board when it comes to CPU, GPU and memory usage with gains up to 40%.
[*] We greatly optimized all physics systems in the game so that they’re now a lot more efficient when performing calculations on the CPU.
[*] Many of the gameplay related calculations have been reworked and more things are loaded and handles asynchronously now. This should result in less hitches and smoother overall gameplay performance.
[*] Car Wash related calculations were rewritten for better performance and strain the CPU a lot less now. Car Wash related game logic and calculations take about 90% less CPU resources now.
[*] VFX and Lighting systems has seen major improvements to avoid a situation when in certain conditions those system would cause high performance costs over time on the entire level.
[*] Optimized the lighting system and settings to consume less resources in general.
[*] Optimized the character animation system to costume less resources as well. This should help with performance especially in later stages of the game.
[*] Certain heavy textures were downsampled to further speed up loading times. These alone should decrease loading time by about 10-15%.
[*] LODs on most vehicles have been improved to look better at closer distances or lower settings.
[*] LODs for characters have been reworked to reduce the amount of weird clipping at lower settings.
[*] LODs for most objects in the game world has been improved upon to further improve GPU performance.
[*] Many optimizations to quest condition checking have been made. Cases where certain objects (like: the grandfather clock from the beginning of the game) when not removed could keep checking overlaps for the remainder of the game causing a minor drop in performance. While each drop on its own was indeed minor, they could add up which would make a noticeable difference especially on lower specs systems.
[/list]

[h3]Other Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Discord link in the main menu should work again allowing you to join our Discord community.
[*] Minor translation fixes in various languages.
[/list]

[h3]Can Touch This DLC[/h3]
[list]
[*] New roof selections have been added to allow you better match roofs with walls.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #4 is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/64e0273b1172f0a3e361f6068428d536fe8dc998.jpg[/img]

Update #4 is a combination of things we have planned for the update #4 itself as well as the previously planned update #5. Due to the delay in update #4, these updates have been combined into one.
The focus of update #4 remains what is was: performance optimizations, saves games and loading times, random crashes and fixes for achievements.

One of the reasons the update #4 took longer than we anticipated was a major rework and clean-up of large potions of the game not only to improve overall performance, but also to allow us to create and introduce more new content into the game more easily. While that might sound like much, it has been of major importance to us considering the large amount of future content we plan for the game.

[h3]Performance[/h3]
- Loading times for game start and loading saved games have been vastly improved. The game now loads less data on various stages of the process and handles it differently. 

- All vehicles have been optimized and require less resources now, meaning they now eat up less performance than they did before. This becomes very noticeable in later stages of the game when there is a lot more traffic on your gas station. These optimizations affect both the CPU and GPU performance.

- Lighting and Shadows had an optimization pass resulting in improved performance especially inside the gas station building.

- First thorough pass of GPU usage, Render optimizations as well as Scalability settings. On lower settings you should now see more difference in quality and bigger savings in GPU usage, VRAM usage as well as regular RAM. Visual quality of textures, vehicles, characters, and shadows of course will be more affected at lower settings. Specifically draw distance makes a large impact on the visuals of skeletal meshes (cars, customers) based on a distance, so tweak accordingly to find what is best for visual / performance gains for your specific hardware.

- The overall memory footprint of the game has seen some nice improvements while we are it at.


[h3]Improvements[/h3]
- AI Pathing has seen some optimization to make especially vehicle AI be a bit smarter now when attempting to drive. This should lead to less traffic pileups and better navigation to their destination and especially exit points. So more situations related to traffic should be solvable on their own, or with minor help of the broom rather than needing to call the UFO.

- AI priority queue has been changed which should allow for cars to come to Fuel / Garage more consistently.

- While working on loading times we also had a close look into issues with saved games reported by some players and made various improvements to how the game handles the save process and improved it.


[h3]Stability[/h3]
- Various random crashes have been caught and fixed. Especially the random crashes resulting from Employees being stuck in loops related to their cleaning and garage repair tasks should now be a thing of the past. 

- We caught various instances responsible for random crashes in later stages of the game and fixed them. We would like to thank all those players who sent us their save game folders along with detailed reports what they were doing and when. It would have not been possible to catch these things without their help.


[h3]Employees[/h3]
- As part of the crash fix, employees when they manage to clean the whole gas station during the cleaning task, should no longer go home and rest. Instead they will wait at last the position of cleaning for more mess to happen. They should only stop cleaning / return to their camper once their energy runs out.


[h3]Other Fixes[/h3]
- Applied a fix to Trash Drop rates, as it turned out customers were really nice and never dropped trash on the floor any more at some point due to a rounding error in our drop chance calculation when we last adjusted it to be lower.

- Fixed an issue where at Popularity Level 10, the amount of cars arriving was wrongly set to Level 1 Popularity.

- Fixed an issue where Rudy was not saving properly. The old saves can't be retroactively fixed by this, but any new saves or even on old saves games should apply the fix. For example if you picked up sand and saved, Rudy would remember that it had Sand, but would on load have lowered the front 'blade', and no sand could be picked up because it was considered full, so you'd need to unload it first before being able to use it. This will still be the case if you load an old save with this situation, however if you drop off the sand, pick up another batch, and save again, that misbehaviour should be fixed in all future saves from that point on.


[h3]Achievements[/h3]
As you are likely aware, we have been struggling with fixing achievements for a few updates now.
While we managed to fix them in the game itself, tons of players still reported issues with achievements. We have spent a lot of time analyzing those reports and working directly with players on discord to track down the issues. As it tuned out, while we missed just a few things in the game previously, the vast majority of issues stemmed from handling the achievements, connection issues or achievement frequencies. Some of these things we could fixed, some were simply beyond our sphere on influence.

We have thus decided to revamp the Achievement System and added it to the game itself rather than being purely reliant on Steam. This means that while you're in-game, you will now see a new Achievement Section in the escape / pause menu where you can also track your achievement progress. 

The system now works locally, meaning as you unlock achievements these are saved locally first and then sends them to Steam for verification. You can find the file holding your achievement data in your Saved/SaveGames folder under AchievementProfileX.sav, where X is your user ID from Steam. 

When loading an older save game it will try to retroactively grant the achievements based on quest progress and stats (the stats are saved in GSS_Stats_X.sav file). So first time you broom, pick up trash, fuel a car, serve a customer, get a tip, buy or steal an indoor decoration, paint a wall, etc. it should read your stats and apply any missing achievements. 

In a future patch we will likely expand on the functionality of the Achievement Section with options resetting them locally, resending them to Steam in case of connections errors or unpredicted issues. Achievements should now also pop on screen in-game in addition to the Steam notification, which might be of importance to players who disable the Steam overlay to squeeze more performance out of their games.

As an added side bonus of this whole endeavour, it will also allow us to add more achivements to the game in future updates, related to new content or expanding the existing stat based achievements, even beyond the 100 achievement limit from Steam. 
Another added bonus for those who just love to do achievements over and over again, if at any point you feel like it, you can reset your local achievements to experience the rush of earning them again, by deleting the AchievementProfileX.sav file in your Saved/SaveGames/ folder :P

[b]Achievements - Known Issue[/b]
During public testing we have discovered an issue where for few players the GSS_Stats_X.sav file was corrupted and they were unable to earn any stats and thus the achievements related to the stats. 
We will attempt to implement a fix for this on our side in the future patch, but as it requires a lot more work and testing, we didn't want to postpone the update even further. 
There is however a workaround. If you see that you're not getting achievements in-game for any stat related achievements as outlined above, you are safe to delete the specific GSS_Stats_X.sav file and they should become earnable as we will regenerate the file later.
Just make sure the game isn't running when you delete the file. 


[h3]Language Versions[/h3]
While we working on update #4, many community members reached out to us offering to translate the game into their language. We are so grateful for that! 
With update #4, the game now supports:
[list]
[*] Croatian
[*] Hungarian
[*] Portugese
[*] Serbian
[*] Vietnamese
[/list]
If you notice any issues with these languages, please report it on our Discord in the translation section.


[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
With update #4 now deployed, part of the team will continue on more improvements, some more optimizations and further bug fixing. Among the improvements will be many requests from the community for gameplay QoL features and adjustments. 
Another part of the team switched back to prepare the Car Wash content update for release, now that the vehicle optimizations planned for update #5 have been included into this update which in turn were required for the Car Wash.

notes.title: Update #4 and #5 insights
notes.notes:
We are currently working on some major optimizations and fixes for the game. These are quite significant and go really deep into the bowels of the game, hence the upcoming updates #4 and #5 take longer to prepare than we needed for previous updates. We’d like to give some insight into what we are doing and what you can expect in the upcoming weeks in terms of stability and performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/f4353fa6d8f6e59d6651ecd08928f61a523efc55.jpg[/img]
One of major goals for update #4 is a drastic improvement of loading times. It took us quite a while to track down the cause and thanks to some very helpful players we were able to pinpoint the sources of the problem. As you might be aware, some players experience extremely long loading times, be it to start the game or load a saved game. This however is not a simple matter of the game not performing that great on a HDD or something like that. As it turned out, all kinds of players are affected, both with SSDs and HDDs. This occasionally is even the case on very beefy machines with seriously fast NVMe SSDs. 

While at it, we are also having another look at the handling of saved game files and improve various behaviours players have experienced in the past, especially when it comes to stability of saved games. We are also addressing a problem some players noticed that the game crashes on rare occasion after performing an auto save. So quite a lot is happening in this area and we can already see great improvements in internal testing.

Another major goal for update #4 is further addressing of random crashes. While the previous patches helped a lot of players already, some players are still suffering from random crashes mostly in later parts of the game. We are reviewing a lot of the saved games sent to us by those players and are getting some really good results from that. A lot of crash instances have been identified and fixed already, more are being worked on. It is likely that we will split the fixes between update #4 and #5 as to not delay the deployment of the fixes unnecessarily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/e24dae9990dade53f970c7ba1c270f43a86bcc80.jpg[/img]
For update #5 we are working on quite large improvements when it comes to performance. It is a combination of smaller optimizations in terms of how visuals are handled and large changes on the technical side, that will result in a significant increase when it comes to FPS.

One of those larger changes is reworking how vehicles in the game are being handled. Right now, all customer vehicles are treated equally. This in turn means, that a vehicle of a customer that only wants to shop or fuel has the same complexity as a vehicle that is meant to be repaired or washed in the upcoming car wash. These vehicles eat up a lot more resources and thus FPS than a simple vehicle would.

What we are doing now is redefine the vehicles and split them into different groups, so that vehicles not meant to go to the workshop or car wash don’t contain all the complexity. Visually it doesn’t change anything, since you don’t see those bits and pieces either way, but it affect performance quite a bit, especially the higher the level of your gas station’s expansion and the more customers arrive.

There are also a lot of smaller optimizations being done to lighting and processing of objects in the scene which in turn greatly reduce the amount of draw calls in later expansion stages of the gas station. These things, while small in itself, add up very quick and provide a very noticeable improvement in FPS across all systems.

Yet another thing that is being done is improving the vehicle behaviour in order for The Red Button to become less of a necessity to use. The way vehicles approach certain areas has been redesigned and vehicle movement in general has seen quite a few improvements. We also found multiple issues in this area that at later stages of the game were responsible for random crashes and these have been fixed, too.

While we don’t have precise dates for update #4 and #5 yet, we expect to be able to deploy update #4 sometime next week followed by update #5 one or two weeks later. Once the optimizations from these updates have been deployed, we will release the car wash next. It’s already good to go, but it relies on the vehicle optimizations, so we can’t release it before those make it into the game.

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/64e0273b1172f0a3e361f6068428d536fe8dc998.jpg[/img]
[h1]Game Update #3[/h1]

This is the third update in a series of updates we are working in order to fix bugs and improve the game. 

[h3]Stability & Performance[/h3]
- Fixed a loading issue in which the game freezes for a couple of seconds before showing a loading screen.
- Various smaller fixes for random crashing issues ahead of Update #4 that will have a much stronger focus on dealing with those.

[h3]Employees[/h3]
- A new UI element now shows relevant information regarding employees and their current status.
- If an employee is repairing a car, the Workshop UI will no longer pop-up on the player's HUD.
- A car repaired by an employee will no longer leave the garage with its hood open.

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
- Players can now sell shelves from inventory (25% of the shelf value) and discard decorations, products and car parts.
- A “Car Parts” tab has been added to the player’s inventory.
- Fixed the car parts delivery issue where large orders sometimes did not arrive. Boxes were visible, but when transferred to the storage no items were added to the inventory.
- Fixed an issue where after completing the Lockpick challenge (open 10 trunks), each opened trunk would give 10 positive feedback.
- The spark plug stand will now store more items.
- A time lock has been added that prevents accidentally stopping car repairs.
- Reduced footprints and trash spawning a bit again. 
- Reduced the frequency of cars honking. 

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
- A Streamer Mode has been added that excludes Denis’ lewd paintings, making the game more underaged audiance friendly.
- Fixed the bug where customers were “flying” around the gas station in a sitting position. 
- Fixed an orientation issue with the sunglasses stand. The glasses will now face in the correct direction.
- Fixed an issue with the biker putting art of the walls that was intended for Denis. Now the biker has his own artistic touch.

[h3]Languages[/h3]
- Various minor linguistic corrections for all languages.


More to come in Update #4, especially lots of [b]optimizations[/b] including [b]loading time[/b] and [b]save game[/b] improvements.

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/64e0273b1172f0a3e361f6068428d536fe8dc998.jpg[/img]
[h1]Game Update #2[/h1]

This is the second update in a series of updates we are working in ordern to improve the game.
The next update is already being work on, but we would rather do smaller, more frequent updates than have you wait for weeks on a large one.


[h3]Stability & Performance[/h3]
- Fixed crashes related to DetachFromActor in Cash Register and Fueling mini-games.
- Ultra Dynamic Sky should no longer update as often which increases performance.
- FPS Lock is now set to 60 FPS by default. The setting will reset any current settings and activate on first run of the game after the update.
- Early game dust particles were removed inside the station at Station Level 4+ as part of the upgrade (minor optimization).
- NPC's were optimized a bit and should now take less resources, resulting in a performance increase.
- Various performance improvements for level 4 and level 5 gas stations.

[h3]Employees[/h3]
- Employees can now jog to get around faster if they have to cover a longer distance.
- Employees should not get stuck in warehouse anymore. They will still go there for now, but they should be able to open doors and not get stuck. In the future will will prevent them from going to warehouse completely.

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
- All walls and roofs should again be paintable.
- You should now be able to quit the Cash Register mini-game at any time with [F].
- Sandstorms should now correctly spawn sand piles again.
- If you hold a product in hand and put it on a shelf, it should no longer open the product placement menu.
- Workshop mini-games should now show a 'key legend' displayed on the side. These might not be  localized yet.
- Items should now overlap less during the Cash Register mini-game. We also changed the scale of some items (newspapers, chips bags, etc.). Both these measures should result in making them less likely to go to the moon randomly.
- Dennis should again make more sounds to make him more easily noticeable.
- Calling the UFO using the Big Red Button when fuel truck arrives should no longer make the fuel from the fuel truck disappear. There will still be two trucks, of which one is empty, but that is a visual glitch to be fixed in an upcoming patch.
- You should now be able to toggle Sandstorms, Dennis Stealing from Warehouse and Party Bus from the Gameplay Options menu to turn them off if you don't like any of them.

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
- 87 Resolution Scale issue has been resolved and resolution scale should now save properly.
- You should no longer see NPC overhead widgets when driving the digger or RC car.
- The animations for no products founds on shelf has been tweaked.

[h3]Save Game[/h3]
- Quicksave (F5) and Quickload (F9) have been added. These keys can't be currently remapped, but that will come in the next update.
- Autosaves now scale up to 5. The newest auto-save will now correctly overwrite the oldest auto-save if 5 auto-saves are already present.
- There should no longer be sparks on the cables after loading a saved game.

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
- We made a lot of fixes to achievements. We also tried as often as possible to have achievements be triggered retroactively. We continue to work on achievements not triggering, but we figured we add at least some fixes to update rather than to wait for all of them. Please give it another try.

[h3]Languages[/h3]
- Translations fixes and added some of the missing translations in various languges.
- Employee UI in non-english languages should look nicer now.

[h3]Other[/h3] 
- Added Reset Character button to the in-game menu. When your character gets stuck somewhere, use it to free yourself.
- Steam Cloud Saving is now available.
- Minor fixes to various UI elements.


More to come in Update #3, especially reworks to [b]dirtiness[/b] and[b] improvements to employees.[/b]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Game Update #1[/h1]

This is the first update in a series of updates we are currently working on to improve the game, get rid of the problems the community reports and also add more languages to the game.

It is important to us that you believe in what we do the same way we do ourselves. We know there are issues with the game right now and we are committed to provide fixes and improvements before we proceed to adding more content to the game. The way we see it, the vast majority of the players like our game a lot. It's just mostly technical issues we need to tackle and these usually "only" take time and commitment - things we feel we certainly have. 

[h3]Stability[/h3]
- Fixed a crash related to customers generating waypoints. We believe this was the cause of a lot of the random crashes players experienced.

[h3]Employees[/h3]
- Fixed an issue where in some cases there would be no employees avaliable to hire even though the quest required you to do so.
- Increased the efficiency of employees who are cleaning. They should now be about 50% faster at cleaning trash.

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
- Reduced the amount of footsteps and trash items the customers leave behind by roughly 33%.

[h3]Controller[/h3]
- Disable Controller option added to the Options menu. This is intended as a temporary fix for the problem where we are detecting some non-controller things (keypads, wheels, bluetooth devices, as controllers). 

[h3]Graphics[/h3]
- Texture Streaming Pool increased on lower settings, which should lead to textures loading faster on lower settings and not staying blurry.

[h3]Languages[/h3]
- Thai language has been added to the game.
- Fixed an issue where people who played the prologue would sometimes get the wrong language set as their primary language when starting the game. This change will reset language to English for everyone on the first run after the patch.

[h3]Other[/h3] 
- Car Workshop doors should now be paintable and lose durability less quickly.
- You should no longer be able to close Warehouse doors while a truck is entering or leaving the warehouse. 
- Added confirmation to deleting Saves & Overwriting existing saves.
- Removed the piece of terrain that was sticking through the ground in the main station.
- Fixed trash being stuck and not be interact-able after loading the game. Also fixes trash on bought decorations being untouchable.
- Removed Giacomo the Snake until we can add the Ophidiophobia mode.
- Autosave should no longer give you extra money on quests where you get money from the Uncle.
- You can now bring up the tool window after throwing items immediately.
- Removed erronerous default binding on Left Arrow Key & Right Arrow Key which turned the character Left/Right

[h2]Known Issue[/h2]
As you're most likely aware, there is an issue where delivery trucks, vehicles/traffic in general and sometimes even customers can get stuck. There is a simple solution to resolve these issues: the [b]Big Red Button[/b]. Located at the Dust Bowl sign it resets these things and restores order at the gas station. Here a short video where to find it:

https://youtu.be/Ii2xPFOZcPM

More to come in Update #2 next week!
